Use N–mm–MPa units and Euler–Bernoulli beam theory (small deflection, linear elastic).
Model a cantilever beam of length L = 1800 mm, fixed at x = 0 and free at x = L.
Apply a downward point load P = 2000 N at the free end.
Use Young's modulus E = 200000 MPa and constant second moment of area I = 1200000 mm^4.
The bending moment varies linearly from PL at the fixed end to zero at the free end.
Fixed-end boundary conditions are zero slope and zero deflection at x = 0.
Compute the free-end slope as θ = PL²/(2EI).
Compute the free-end deflection as δ = PL³/(3EI).
Report the slope in radians, with degrees as a secondary value.
Report the deflection in mm.
